name: mcpkeel
description: Checks this project's MCP servers against mcp.lock when a session starts, and asks before, or blocks, calls to a server that changed.

on_drift.title: When a server changed
on_drift.description: What happens to a call to a tool of a server that no longer matches mcp.lock: ask you first, deny it, or only warn at session start.

on_unverified.title: When a server could not be checked
on_unverified.description: What happens to a call to a server mcpkeel could not reach or finish checking.

fail_on.title: Lowest severity that counts
fail_on.description: Changes below this severity are reported but do not gate a server.

timeout.title: Per-server timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: How long mcpkeel waits for each server when the session starts.
